BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1457.name: The HieroglyphSoldier Early-Jehuty
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1457.effect:
[Unleash: 1, Minor] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
Once per turn, when your "Armed Machine" family Spirit is summoned, by sending a core from any of your exactly-named "Grandwalker Thoth" to the Trash, immediately activate that Grandwalker Nexus' [LV1][LV2] [Grand Field], changing the "Ultimate" text written in the effect into "Spirit" and treating core as being sent to the Void.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Nexus/Purple Spirit effects.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3624.name: Dairokuten Maou (Card)
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3624.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: ("God-Sechs"/Evil Shadow/Clever Machine & Cost 2 or more) (This Nexus can only hold up to 5 cores)]
◆When you Summon/Advent a target Spirit, put a core from the Void to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[Grand Field] [LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When you're summoning a "God-Sechs"-named card, by exhausting this Nexus, treat all the reductions of that card as fulfilled.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your "God-Sechs"-named Spirit with [Soul Core] on it is attacking, the opponent can't use Magic cards/[Accel] unless they send their [Soul Core] to their Trash.

LM18-07.name: Garudos Randall (Card)
LM18-07.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Ruin Dragon/Ancient Dragon/Dragon Warrior & Cost 3 or more) (Exalted Sword & Brave)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit/Brave, put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 4] [LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
(Once per turn, send four core from this Nexus to the void) Pay one cost to summon a "Ruin Dragon"/"Exalted Sword" family card from your Hand/Removed Zone.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
At the end of the battle of your Brave Spirits that are braved to any "Exalted Sword" family Brave, send an opposing Life to the Void. This effect doesn't stack.
